name: WNBA_R1A4B_ADVANCED_ASOF_SEMANTICS_AUDIT_V1

scope.goal: Determine whether season-to-date offRtg, defRtg, netRtg and pace can be reconstructed as-of from prior-game data with semantics sufficiently equivalent to the frozen production source chain.

frozen_production_semantics.production_quantization: round to one decimal before model consumption

target_cohort_access_probe.purpose: Prove historical game-level advanced access without requesting a hypothetical target date.
target_cohort_access_probe.required: Each season must return nonzero full-game advanced rows from dates strictly before the hypothetical target date.

semantic_equivalence_validation.reason: 2026 is outside the 2021-2025 historical evaluation cohort and is used only to validate source aggregation semantics, not to tune model coefficients, thresholds or candidate selection.

candidate_formula_frozen_before_probe.name: POSSESSION_RATIO_FROM_GAME_ADVANCED_V1
candidate_formula_frozen_before_probe.pace_if_advanced_season_field_absent: mean game-level [FGA + 0.44*FTA - OREB + TOV], equivalent to production base-stat fallback before one-decimal quantization
candidate_formula_frozen_before_probe.simple_mean_game_ratings: diagnostic only; may not replace the preregistered possession-ratio formula after results are observed

semantic_equivalence_validation.comparison_population: Only 2026 teams whose game-level advanced/basic row counts exactly match the season snapshot gp are eligible for the equivalence comparison.

anti_leakage_rules: The 2021-2025 probe requests only June 1-7 prior-game windows for hypothetical June 15 targets.
No June 15 target-game advanced row, target score, target winner, market price, target participation or post-tip target information may be requested during R1A.4B.
2026 may be used only for source-semantic equivalence and cannot change WNBA model coefficients, thresholds, feature definitions or the SPORTS_ONLY_V1 candidate.
A final-season advanced snapshot from 2021-2025 may not be substituted backward to construct earlier target rows.
If the preregistered reconstruction exceeds the frozen tolerance, R1A.4B is not certified; the tolerance may not be widened after observing the comparison.
Unknown historical injury/manual state remains unresolved and is not zero-filled by this gate.
